name: ui-underline-stretch
title: Sliding Underline
description: Gạch chân dưới tab chạy sang tab mới: mép trước đi trước, mép sau đuổi theo sau 0.09 s nên vạch giãn ra rồi thu về đúng bề rộng.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Tabs HOME / WORK / SAVE at x 88 / 160 / 232 on a 240x64 card; underline 44x3 r1.5. Each move: the edge on the travel side moves over 0.26 s power2.out, the other edge over 0.34 s power2.inOut starting 0.09 s later. Moves at 0.3 s (1→2), 1.15 s (2→3), 2.0 s (3→1). Labels brighten as the underline centre comes within 50 px; a faint outline marks the target while moving. Params: lead (0.26 s, power2.out) · trail (0.34 s, trễ 0.09 s) · width (44 px) · moves [[giây, từ, tới]]. The edge on the travel side leads (0.26 s, power2.out); the other follows 0.09 s later (0.34 s, power2.inOut), so the line stretches and settles.
moworks.titleVi: Gạch chân tab trượt co giãn
